name: Tile
description: Raster tile layer (TMS/WMTS/COG/STAC) rendered as a Leaflet tileLayer on the map and imagery on the globe.

supportedData.label: Templated raster tiles (TMS / WMTS)
supportedData.description: 256px raster image tiles addressed by zoom/column/row, in either TMS (bottom-origin) or WMTS/XYZ (top-origin) axis order.
supportedData.procurement: Produce with MMGIS auxiliary tiling scripts or gdal2tiles; host as static files or a tile service.

supportedData.label: Web Map Service (WMS)
supportedData.description: OGC WMS endpoint rendered per-request. Append ?layers=<layer[,layer]>; extra WMS params and &TILESIZE= supported.
supportedData.procurement: Any OGC-compliant WMS server (GeoServer, MapServer, mundialis, etc.).

supportedData.label: GeoTIFF (whole-file)
supportedData.description: A single .tif fetched in full by the client (not tiled). Best for small rasters.

supportedData.label: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG)
supportedData.description: A COG dynamically tiled by TiTiler. Supports band selection (bidx), resampling, band-math expressions, colormaps and min/max rescale of single-data-band COGs.
supportedData.procurement: gdal_translate <in> <out>.tif -of COG; requires the TiTiler adjacent server.

supportedData.label: STAC collection (mosaicked COGs)
supportedData.description: A STAC collection whose member COGs are mosaicked and served as WMTS tiles via titiler-pgstac. Local or external instances.
supportedData.procurement: Index COGs into a STAC collection; requires the titiler-pgstac adjacent server.
